'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Crimea attacks (2022–present)|Crimea attacks]]
***[[2023 missile strike on the Sevastopol Naval Base]]
****The [[Sevastopol Naval Base|headquarters]] of the [[Black Sea Fleet]] in [[Sevastopol]], [[Crimea]], is hit in a [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] missile attack, killing at least one person and causing a fire in the building. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/22/black-sea-navy-hq-hit-in-crimea-missile-attack-one-dead-russia (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Mali War]]
**Two people are killed and five others are wounded in a [[Mortar (weapon)|mortar]] attack on [[Timbuktu]], [[Mali]], by [[jihadism|jihadist]] insurgents. The city remains under [[siege]] by insurgents with reports of food, petrol and medicine [[shortage]]s. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-66887546 (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2023 United Auto Workers strike]]
**In the [[Economy of the United States|United States]], [[United Auto Workers]] president [[Shawn Fain]] announces that the union will expand their strikes to 38 locations. [https://www.cnbc.com/2023/09/22/uaw-strike-expands-to-38-more-facilities-at-gm-and-stellantis.html (CNBC)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Six people are killed, more than 100 others are injured, and three are missing after a fire and subsequent explosions at a [[golf ball]] factory in [[Pingtung County]], [[Taiwan]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2023-09-23/taiwan-factory-fire-leaves-at-least-six-dead-100-injured/102893828 (ABC News Australia)]
*One person is killed and four others are injured after an incident at an [[oil refinery]] in [[Bandar Abbas]], [[Hormozgan province]], [[Iran]]. [https://www.newarab.com/news/iran-1-dead-4-injured-incident-bandar-abbas-refinery (Reuters via ''The New Arab'')]
*The [[Taal Volcano]] in [[Batangas]], [[Philippines]], releases elevated levels of [[sulfur dioxide]] and [[vog]], resulting in school closures, including in [[Metro Manila]]. Residents in affected areas are asked to avoid outdoor activities. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippine-issues-health-warning-volcano-brings-smog-capital-nearby-provinces-2023-09-22/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–Syria relations]]
**[[President of Syria|Syrian President]] [[Bashar al-Assad]] meets with Chinese President [[Xi Jinping]] in [[Hangzhou]], [[China]], and signs a strategic partnership on infrastructure as part of China's [[Belt and Road Initiative]]. [https://english.news.cn/20230922/6c629b0667aa49dc902249b4c2a6012c/c.html (Xinhua)] [https://apnews.com/article/china-syria-asian-games-diplomacy-assad-xi-cce801eaa586fe5db82d28df79b0f91f (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Turkey–Islamic State conflict]], [[terrorism in Turkey]]
**[[Turkey|Turkish]] [[Law enforcement in Turkey|police]] announce that they have detained 10 people with links to the [[Islamic State]] in [[Izmir]] after intelligence revealed hidden [[improvised explosive device|explosives]] manufacturing supplies. [https://english.aawsat.com/world/4562376-turkish-police-detain-10-accused-isis-links-minister-says (''Asharq Al-Awsat'')]
*[[United States Senate|U.S. Senator]] [[Bob Menendez]] and his wife Nadina are indicted on federal corruption charges for allegedly accepting bribes to provide sensitive information to the [[Politics of Egypt|government]] of [[Egypt]]. [https://www.npr.org/2023/09/22/1201038817/robert-menendez-indicted (NPR)]
